svg.text: Chronology - Where These AI Methods Fit Over the Last ~20 Years
Bars = roughly when each was the emerging/dominant approach. Arrows = continues before or after the window shown. Color = output type.
◀ / ▶ arrows = extends before or after the ~20-year window shown (started earlier, or still active today). ● = a notable named milestone.
Dates are approximate, meant for orientation, not precise history. Bar length is not a claim about relative importance.
